description: This PHP source file defines the ConfigBuilder class, which provides a fluent interface for creating and overriding configuration objects for a documentation generation system. It includes methods for loading configuration files, setting various configuration options, resolving themes, and validating paths.

classes.name: ConfigBuilder
classes.description: A class that builds and customizes configuration objects for documentation generation, supporting loading from files, merging values, and theme resolution.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a ConfigBuilder instance with a specified mode, setting default configurations.

methods.name: fromFile
methods.description: Loads and unserializes a Config object from a given file.

methods.name: withMode
methods.description: Creates a new ConfigBuilder instance with a specified mode and loads base configuration.

methods.name: with
methods.description: Merges an array of values into the current configuration.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets a nested configuration value based on dot notation keys.

methods.name: withValues
methods.description: Overrides configuration values with a provided array.

methods.name: withDocumentationDirectory
methods.description: Sets the documentation directory path.

methods.name: withValidContentExtensions
methods.description: Sets valid content file extensions.

methods.name: withThemesPath
methods.description: Sets the themes path.

methods.name: withThemesDirectory
methods.description: Sets the themes directory.

methods.name: withCache
methods.description: Enables or disables cache.

methods.name: withFormat
methods.description: Sets the output format.

methods.name: withConfigurationOverride
methods.description: Sets a file for configuration override.

methods.name: withProcessor
methods.description: Sets the processor value.

methods.name: withConfluenceDelete
methods.description: Sets Confluence delete flag.

methods.name: withConfluencePrintDiff
methods.description: Sets Confluence print diff flag.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Finalizes and returns the constructed Config object, initializing and applying overrides.

methods.name: resolveThemeVariant
methods.description: Determines the theme and variant, checking for directory existence and handling theme naming conventions.

methods.name: initializeConfiguration
methods.description: Performs validation and loads default and override configurations, setting paths and theme variants, and timezone.

methods.name: normalizeThemePath
methods.description: Checks and normalizes the themes path.

methods.name: normalizeDocumentationPath
methods.description: Checks and normalizes the documentation path.

methods.name: loadBaseConfiguration
methods.description: Loads the default base configuration, merging global settings.

methods.name: loadConfiguration
methods.description: Loads a JSON configuration file and merges its contents.

methods.name: getConfigurationOverride
methods.description: Determines the override configuration file path.

methods.name: findLocation
methods.description: Finds a valid location for a given path, relative to a base directory.
